notes: Saturn V desk replica 0.52 m (1:212.7) on a 25 mm black lacquer stand with a blank brass plate; stylised black/white roll pattern, orange escape tower, silver service module; no flags or lettering. Radially symmetric; the brass plate marks the front (+Z). Rocket width 0.047 m (fin span 0.085 m); the extent is the stand.

identities.author: art/exhibits/rocket/author_rocket.py (lathes from public Saturn V proportions, livery strip texture)

source.permission: Original. The reference rocket GLB's asset.extras states license CC-BY-ND-4.0 (Sketchfab, NoDerivatives): it may not be distributed modified, so it was not used for geometry, texture or measurement; this replica is authored from general public dimensions only.

inspection.verdict: reads as a Saturn V model: three stages, conical transitions, fins and engine fairings, five bells, spacecraft and escape tower
